changelog: Initial release - one-click Windows installer that installs straight to Local Disk C (C:\DroidForgePACExtractor), plus the portable exe. New built-in Check Update button next to Refresh: one tap checks GitHub and pops up the result with a button straight to the download page. The window opens fully fitted to your screen. Extract Spreadtrum/Unisoc .pac firmware with per-file checkboxes, a real CRC integrity check, drag & drop, and a full English/Indonesian interface.
